WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT h.batting_hand,
       h.fielding_count,
       1.0 * h.fielding_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total,
       h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts AS h
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count
